summary: The World, also called The World Islands, is an artificial archipelago off the coast of Dubai in the Persian Gulf, built in the rough shape of a world map. The islands are made mainly of sand dredged from Dubai's shallow coastal waters and are one of several artificial island developments in Dubai. Nakheel Properties developed the project, which was originally conceived by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, and two Dutch joint-venture firms, Van Oord and Boskalis, carried out the construction, the same companies that also created the Palm Jumeirah.
one_line: The World Islands is an artificial archipelago shaped like a world map, built off Dubai's coast in the Persian Gulf.
key_facts: The World, also called The World Islands, is an artificial archipelago of small islands in the Persian Gulf off the coast of Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
The archipelago is constructed in the rough shape of a world map.
The Arabic name of The World is "Juzur al-Ālam" (جزر العالم).
The World islands are composed mainly of sand dredged from Dubai's shallow coastal waters.
The World is one of several artificial island developments in Dubai.
The World's developer is Nakheel Properties.
The project was originally conceived by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the ruler of Dubai.
The actual construction was done by two Dutch joint-venture specialist companies, Van Oord and Boskalis.
Van Oord and Boskalis also created the Palm Jumeirah.
